Lines

Which lines show, in what order, and how they are joined

Order & visibility
When it doesn't fit

Drop priority

VRChat shows 144 characters and 9 lines. When the chatbox is longer, Fern first shortens lines (media loses its bar, then its time, then album and feat. credits), then drops whole lines from the top of this list. Media is cut to fit before it is dropped. The last line left is cut with “…”. This is separate from the display order above.
Chatbox
Display Master switch. When off, nothing is sent to VRChat.
Separator How lines are joined together
Line prefix Put before every line, e.g. “» ”. Counts toward the 144 characters.
Line suffix Put after every line
Do not disturb
Do not disturb Hides every line except the ones below. Messages you send still show. Also on the Live page, the tray menu, a shortcut and in rules.
Still show Lines that stay while do not disturb is on
Shortcut Turns do not disturb on or off from any app. Click the box and press the keys; Backspace clears it.
Motion
Step length How long each step of a moving line stays up, in seconds. VRChat drops chatbox updates sent faster than about one a second, so a step is never shorter than that. While something moves, the chatbox is sent once per step.
Scroll shows a window of a long line that moves along. Typewriter types a line out when it changes, starting from the part that changed. Blink shows a line every other step. Effects run before the fit, so a scrolling line takes up only its window.
Pages
Take turns Shows one page of lines at a time, each for its own time, then the next. Lines in no page show on every page. A page with nothing to show is skipped.
Blocked worlds
Pause in blocked worlds Clubs and events often ask for no chatbox. In a blocked world Fern only shows the lines below and messages you send yourself. Like VRCOSC, this is on unless you turn it off.
Community list The list VRCOSC uses, kept by club owners on GitHub. Fern downloads it once a day; nothing is sent.
Still show Lines that stay in a blocked world. Heart rate stays by default, as in VRCOSC.
This world Not in a world
Your blocked worlds Blocked even with the community list off. Paste a world id (wrld_…), or use Block above while you are there.
Never blocked Community worlds you unblocked. The chatbox shows there as usual.

no profile

Active profile

No profile is active, so changes only change the current settings.
New profile Saves the current setup under a name and makes it the active profile
Stop saving to a profile The settings stay as they are; later changes no longer go into any profile

Your profiles

0
Switch here, from the quick switcher on the Live page, from the tray icon's menu, or with a profile's shortcut, which works in any app. stores the panel's current look (Appearance page) with a profile, so switching changes it too.
Profiles leave out API keys and sign-ins, the window, tray and mic shortcut, where the chatbox is sent (Output), the Assist tools, the Display switch, tracker names and saved bar styles. Those stay as they are when you switch.

Rules

When something happens, Fern does something: a profile for one world, quiet while you're AFK, a hello when a friend joins

no rules

New rule

Name Optional; shown in the list
When
Only if
Then
Options
Undo when it ends Puts back what the actions changed once the trigger stops holding
Cooldown Seconds before the rule may fire again; 0 is none
On Off keeps the rule without running it
Rules are checked from the top, so when two change the same thing the lower one wins. A rule whose trigger holds for a while (a world, a time, AFK) fires once when it starts, and with Undo when it ends puts things back when it stops. runs a rule's actions right away.
Matching text is case-insensitive and finds the text anywhere; write /regex/ for a regular expression. Rules stay the same when you switch profiles.

Parameters Fern reads and sends

none sent yet
ParameterTypeFernWhat it isNow
Names go after /avatar/parameters/: FernMediaNext is /avatar/parameters/FernMediaNext. Give your avatar parameters with these names, or type the names your avatar already uses; empty a name to stop using it. A parameter Fern reads acts when it turns on: a bool becoming true, an int above 0 or a float above 0.5, so a button in your expression menu works.
Floats are 0 to 1. The hour float is the hour hand's turn and moves with the minutes; CPU, GPU and RAM are the load. Pulses are true for a moment, then false. Everything goes to the same address as the chatbox (Output page).

Keys and apps from a parameter

When this parameter turns on A bool, an int above 0 or a float above 0.5
Fern does Holding and opening are undone when the parameter turns off
Keys Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win plus one key, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+M, F13 or MediaPlayPause
App A full path, or a program Windows knows like notepad.exe
App Its exe name. Asking lets it save first; End task stops it at once.
Media Works on what is playing, like the media keys
This adds a rule on the Rules page, where you can change it or add conditions. Rules can also press keys, open or close apps and control media from any other trigger, like a world, a time or a friend joining.

Sensors

Temperatures, power, clocks and fans, read from HWiNFO or LibreHardwareMonitor

—
Show the sensors line Adds the sensors you pick below to the chatbox, in the order set on Lines

Source

Read from Windows has no shared way to read these without a driver, so Fern asks a monitoring app you run. Automatic tries HWiNFO, then LibreHardwareMonitor.
LibreHardwareMonitor address Its web server's data.json. Applies when you click away.
Status Waiting for the first read
HWiNFO: open its Settings, tick Shared Memory Support and keep HWiNFO running (the sensors window can stay closed). The free version turns sharing off after 12 hours; tick it again when the readings stop.
LibreHardwareMonitor: run it as administrator, then in Options turn on Remote Web Server and Run (port 8085). While it runs as administrator Fern can also read it through WMI without the web server.
Label Prefix before the sensors. Leave empty for none.
Each sensor {name} {value} {num} {unit} {min} {max} {hardware}
Between sensors Spaces count
Fahrenheit Temperatures in °F instead of °C
On the line 0
Name a sensor to change what {name} shows. A sensor that is missing right now (the app is closed, or the part was removed) is skipped.
All sensors 0
Find Hardware, name or type, such as “gpu temp” or “fan”

Spotify

off
Use the Spotify Web API Optional. Adds liked songs, shuffle, repeat, the device and the playlist, plus controls. The track itself still comes from Windows.
  1. In the Spotify Developer Dashboard press Create app. Any name works; tick Web API.
  2. Add this Redirect URI to the app: http://127.0.0.1:1931/callback
  3. Copy its Client ID below and press Sign in with Spotify. Fern keeps the sign-in fresh by itself. Controls need Spotify Premium.
Client ID From your app in the dashboard. No client secret is needed.
Sign-in port Fern listens on this port only while you sign in. Change it if it is busy, then update the Redirect URI.
Controls Like the song, shuffle and repeat
Volume Of the device Spotify plays on
–
Device Moves playback to another Spotify Connect device
Add to queue A song link, a spotify: URI or search words; the first match is queued
Check every How often Fern asks Spotify
5s

Avatar parameters
Send to my avatar OSC parameters to the same address as the chatbox. Works with the line off too.
Heart rate (int) Whole bpm, 0–255, once a second. HR fits the Pulsoid and HypeRate prefabs.
Heart rate (float) bpm ÷ 255. −1…1 is the HeartRateFloat convention; 0…1 matches HRPercent.
Beat (bool) Flips every beat (HeartBeatToggle) or is true for a moment each beat (isHRBeat)
Connected (bool) True while fresh readings arrive
Names go after /avatar/parameters/. Empty a name to stop sending that parameter.

Voice

                        
Voice commands, and word replacements for what you type, dictate and hear

                    

                


                

                    

                        
Voice commands

                        none
                    

                    
Say a phrase into dictation (the  button under Send now) and a rule runs: switch a profile, set an avatar parameter, send a message. Each command is a rule with the trigger I say a voice command, so it can have conditions and several actions.

                    
Rules are paused, so voice commands do nothing. Turn them on from the Rules page.

                    

                    

                        No command heard yet
                        
                    

                    
Matching ignores case and punctuation. Only while holding the mic button makes a command push to talk only, and Don't send it to the chatbox keeps those words out of Send now. With Starts with, a chat message's {name} is whatever you said after the phrase.

                


                

                    

                        
Word filter

                        off
                    

                    

                        

                            Typed messages
                            What you send or live type from Send now
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Dictation
                            What speech to text hears, before it reaches Send now
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Read aloud
                            What text to speech says. Censored words are skipped instead of masked.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    
Replace 

                    

                    
                    
Runs top to bottom. Plain text matches whole words in any case and keeps the capitals (brb → be right back, BRB → BE RIGHT BACK). Write /regex/ for a regular expression, with $1 for its groups.

                    
Censor

                    

                        

                            Words to hide
                            One per line, whole words in any case, or /regex/. Saved when you click away.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Mask
                            Covers each letter of a hidden word
                        

                        

                    

                    

                    
Replacements run before the censor list, so a replacement can't bring a hidden word back. With both Typed and Dictation on, dictated text you then send is filtered twice, which only matters for replacements that contain their own pattern.

Controller input

                

                    

                        

                            Send controller input to your avatar
                            Sticks, trackpads, triggers and fingers as avatar parameters over OSC
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Read with
                            SteamVR Input is the only way to get finger curl; the legacy state has axes and buttons. This also picks how haptics are played.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Read while a game has focus
                            Reads SteamVR Input at overlay priority. SteamVR then takes the bound inputs away from VRChat, so only turn this on if nothing arrives otherwise.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Name prefix
                            Put before every name, e.g. “Ctl/” gives Ctl/LeftStickX. Empty matches ThumbParams-style avatars.
                        

                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Updates per second
                            Only values that changed are sent
                        

                        

                            
                            10
                        

                    

                

                

                    

                        

                            Thumbsticks
                            LeftStickX, LeftStickY and the right ones, floats −1 to 1
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Trackpads
                            LeftPadX, LeftPadY, floats, and LeftPadTouch, a bool
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Trigger and grip
                            LeftTrigger and LeftGrip, floats 0 to 1
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Finger curl
                            LeftThumbCurl … LeftPinkyCurl, floats 0 (open) to 1 (fist). SteamVR Input only; Index controllers track every finger.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Thumb position
                            LeftThumb, an int: 0 nothing, 1 A/X, 2 B/Y, 3 trackpad, 4 thumbstick
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Directions
                            LeftStickDir and LeftPadDir, ints: 0 centre, then 1 up, 2 right, 3 down, 4 left. A trackpad only points while touched.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Eight directions
                            1 up, 2 up-right … 8 up-left, clockwise
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Direction dead zone
                            How far the stick or thumb must be from the centre
                        

                        

                            
                            50%
                        

                    

                


                
Sending now

                

                    

                    
Nothing yet. Turn controller input on while SteamVR runs.

                

                
Fern is a background SteamVR app, and SteamVR may give a background app's input actions nothing while a game has input focus. Auto then falls back to the legacy state, which has no fingers; the status at the top says which one answered. Read while a game has focus gets past that at the cost of the game's input. Change the bindings under SteamVR Settings, Controllers, Manage controller bindings, Fern.

Chat

                

                    

                        

                            Live typing rate
                            With live typing on, how often the message is sent while you type. VRChat drops messages that come faster than about one a second.

                            Typing indicator
                            Show VRChat's typing bubble while you write a message on the Live page
                        

                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Remember sent messages
                            Keep the last 20 messages from “Send now” to resend with a click. Turning this off forgets them.

                            Suggest a whole earlier message as you type it; Tab takes it
                        

                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Sound for sent messages
                            VRChat plays its chatbox sound once for each message from “Send now”
                        

                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Sound for automatic updates
                            Plays whenever the chatbox text changes. With the clock or loading dots on, that is often.

Receiving

                

                    

                        
From VRChat

                        starting
                    

                    

                        

                            OSCQuery
                            Listen on a free port and let VRChat find it over OSCQuery, so other OSC apps can keep port 9001. Off, Fern listens on 9001 itself.
                        

                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Status
                            
                        

                    

                


                

                    

                        
Forward received OSC

                        off
                    

                    
Pass what VRChat sends Fern on to other OSC apps, up to eight. Leave the filter empty to forward everything, or give the start of the addresses to pass on, like /avatar/parameters/.

                    

                    

                        
                    

                


                
Every change is saved to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Fern\config.json as you make it.

Start with SteamVR

                        off
                    

                    

                        

                            Register Fern with SteamVR
                            SteamVR then opens Fern minimised when it starts and Fern quits when SteamVR closes. SteamVR has to be running while you press this. You can switch it off later in SteamVR's settings under Startup / Shutdown, or with Remove.

Backup and restore

                        0 backups
                    

                    

                        

                            Settings file
                            Every setting and profile in one file, without API keys, tokens or sign-ins. Importing replaces the current settings and profiles; Fern backs them up first.
                        

                        

                            
                            
                        

                    

                    
                    

                        

                            Automatic backups
                            Made before each update is installed and before an import or restore. Fern keeps the last 10.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                

            


            
            

                

                    

                        
API

                        
Control Fern from a Stream Deck, Touch Portal, Streamer.bot or a script on this PC

                    

                    off
                


                

                    

                        

                            Local control API
                            HTTP and WebSocket on 127.0.0.1. Only programs on this PC that know the token can use it; web pages never can.
                        

                        

                            
                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Port
                            1930 unless another app needs it. Tools use http://127.0.0.1:port/api
                        

                        

                    

                    

                        

                            Token
                            Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>, an X-Fern-Token header or ?token=. A new token stops every tool that has the old one.
                        

                        

                            
                            
                            
                            
                        

                    

                    
Off. Turn it on to get a token and a port.

Calls

                        
                    

                    
Every call works as GET with the settings in the address, or as POST with a form, a JSON object or plain text (the text to send). The answer is JSON: {"ok":true,"result":…} or {"ok":false,"error":"…"}. Rules can react to /api/event with the Control API call trigger.

             Setup
            


            

                
Welcome to Fern

                
Fern writes lines like the song you're playing, the time or your own messages into VRChat's chatbox, over OSC.

                
This takes a minute: check that VRChat's OSC is on, send a test message, then pick the lines to start with. Everything can be changed later.

            


            

                
VRChat's OSC

                
VRChat only talks to apps like Fern with OSC switched on: open the Action Menu, then Options › OSC › Enabled.

                

                    
VRChat

                    
OSC switch

                    
OSC folder

                    
OSC traffic

                

                
These update by themselves while this is open.

            


            

                
Test send

                

                

                    
                

                

                    Did it show up above your head?
                    
                    
                

                
Fern reaches your chatbox. On to the lines.

                

                    
    
                        
  • Check that OSC is on in VRChat (Action Menu › Options › OSC › Enabled). Switching it off and on again resets it.
    • 
                        
  • Your chatbox has to be visible: VRChat hides it when the chatbox is turned off in its settings.
    • 
                        
  • Fern sends to the address on the Output page, normally 127.0.0.1 port 9000. Another OSC app can't hold that port for VRChat.
    • 
                        
  • A firewall or VPN can block local OSC; allow Fern and VRChat on private networks.
    • 
                    

                

            


            

                
Starter lines

                
Pick what the chatbox shows. A preset fills in a few; click a line to add or remove it. The order and each line's look are on the Lines and Modules pages.

                

                

                

            


            

                
All set

                
Fern is sending your lines. Arrange them on the Lines page, fine-tune each one on its own page, and type messages on the Live page.

                
You can run this setup again from the App page.
